description: Pipelines is a dataset listed in Province of New Brunswick open data portal (gnb.socrata.com), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Province of New Brunswick. Approximate centerline location of major energy transmission pipelines including the name of each pipeline. / Emplacement médiane approximative des principaux pipelines de transport d'énergie, y compris le nom de chaque pipeline. Coverage: New Brunswick. The portal files it under the category GeoNB. Its tags are pipeline, gas, geonb, new brunswick, nouveau-brunswick. The table has 4 columns. Attribution on the portal: Service New Brunswick / Service Nouveau-Brunswick. The portal shows 2018-04-11 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is New Brunswick Open Government Licence. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support pipeline routing and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-gnb-socrata-com-portal.
